name: openshift-autologin
description: Chrome extension for auto-login to OpenShift and vSphere clusters

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run validate:manifest
scripts.validate:manifest: jq empty manifest.json && echo '✅ manifest.json is valid'
scripts.package: zip -r extension.zip manifest.json popup.html popup.js content.js background.js icon*.png README.md -x '*.git*' 'node_modules/*' 'dist/*' '.claude/*'

author: prsurve
